---

| Order | Assignment | Course | Priority | Status & Deadline | Progress | Why This Order |

| **2** | **NumPy Broadcasting & Vectorized Matrix Ops Lab** | Advanced Python | **High** | **Overdue 2 days (Nov 22)** | 1/3 subtasks | Highest urgency overdue task (High priority, 2 days late). Finish and submit today to stop late penalties from growing. |
| **3** | **Eigenvalues, SVD & Principal Component Analysis Problem Set** | Mathematics | **Medium** | **Overdue 1 day (Nov 23)** | 1/2 subtasks | Halfway done and 1 day overdue. Clear this tonight or early tomorrow morning. |
| **4** | **B+ Tree Indexing & Query Execution Plan Analysis** | DBMS | **High** | **Due Tomorrow (Nov 25)** | 0/2 subtasks | High priority and hasn't been started yet—begin setup/queries tonight and finish tomorrow. |

| **7** | **Automated Unit Testing & CI Pipeline Proposal** | Software Engineering | Low | Due in 8 days (Dec 2) | 0 subtasks | Low priority with plenty of buffer; handle Nov 29–Dec 1. |

---

### Recommended Game Plan for Today (Tue, Nov 24) & Tomorrow (Wed, Nov 25)

1. **Right Now — Finish the OS Scheduler Simulation:** Since you're already at **2/3 subtasks**, finish your final comparison/report section and submit before tonight's deadline.
2. **Next Today — Complete the Overdue NumPy Lab:** Knock out the remaining 2 subtasks (vectorized kernels/benchmarking + submission) so all High-priority overdue work is off your plate.
3. **Tonight / Early Tomorrow — Clear the SVD Problem Set & Start DBMS:** Finish the remaining half of your Math problem set, and at least initialize the 500k-row PostgreSQL schema and run your first `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` queries before going to sleep so tomorrow's **B+ Tree Indexing** deadline stays stress-free.
